description: Get personalised, ranked scholarship recommendations for an African student based on their full profile. Uses StudiePoint's matching algorithm to score scholarships by GPA fit, field alignment, visa accessibility, deadline urgency, and acceptance rate. Returns top matches with match score, reasoning, and direct application links.

converted_gpa.description: Student's GPA already converted to the 4.0 scale. Use convert_gpa first if needed.

limit.description: Number of top matches to return. Default 3, maximum 3 in the public preview.

name: match_scholarships
